Plan: Detect screen width changes to switch button layout direction between horizontal (PC) and vertical (Mobile).

```
--!strict
-- LocalScript (StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ResponsiveMenu"
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
layout.Parent = screenGui

for i = 1, 3 do
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 50)
	btn.Text = "Button " .. i
	btn.Parent = screenGui
end

screenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
	if screenGui.AbsoluteSize.X < 600 then
		layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	else
		layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	end
end)

```

Explanation: Dynamically updates the `UIListLayout` fill direction based on the viewport width.

--!strict
-- ModuleScript (ReplicatedStorage/ConfirmDialog)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local module = {}

function module.Prompt(title: string, message: string): boolean
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
	
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 150)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -75)
	
	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
	lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
	lbl.Text = message
	
	local yes = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	yes.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 40)
	yes.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.65, 0)
	yes.Text = "Yes"
	
	local no = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	no.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 40)
	no.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.65, 0)
	no.Text = "No"
	
	local result: boolean? = nil
	yes.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() result = true end)
	no.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() result = false end)
	
	while result == nil do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	
	gui:Destroy()
	return result
end

return module

```

Plan: Create a client-side health bar above the hotbar that tweens smoothly when health changes and shifts to red below 25%.

```
--!strict
-- LocalScript (StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "HealthBarGui"
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 20)
bg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.85, 0)
bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
bg.Parent = screenGui

local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
fill.Parent = bg

local function onCharacterAdded(character: Model)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	
	local function updateHealth()
		local healthPercent = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
		local targetColor = healthPercent <= 0.25 and Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
		
		TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
			Size = UDim2.new(healthPercent, 0, 1, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = targetColor
		}):Play()
	end
	
	humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(updateHealth)
	updateHealth()
end

if player.Character then
	onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)

```

Explanation: Listens to the player's `Humanoid.HealthChanged` event, using `TweenService` to smoothly adjust the fill size and color dynamically.

fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)

local stamina = 100
local maxStamina = 100
local lastChangeTime = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	-- Simulated stamina usage logic hook
	if stamina < maxStamina then
		bg.Visible = true
	elseif tick() - lastChangeTime > 2 then
		bg.Visible = false
	end
	fill.Size = UDim2.new(stamina / maxStamina, 0, 1, 0)
end)

```

Explanation: Automatically manages visibility based on usage state and idle timers.

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		for t = 120, 0, -1 do
			local minutes = math.floor(t / 60)

			timerEvent:FireAllClients(string.format("%02d:%02d", minutes, seconds))

		end
	end

Plan: Listen to number keys 1-5 to equip corresponding tools from the player's backpack and highlight the active slot.

```
--!strict
-- LocalScript (StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts)

local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack") :: Backpack
local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid or player.CharacterAdded:Wait():WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid

local function selectSlot(slotNumber: number)
	local tools = backpack:GetChildren()
	local tool = tools[slotNumber]
	if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
		humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
	end
end

for i = 1, 5 do
	local keyCode = Enum.KeyCode[tostring(i)]
	ContextActionService:BindAction("Hotbar" .. i, function(_, state)
		if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			selectSlot(i)
		end
	end, false, keyCode)
end
```

Explanation: Binds keys 1–5 to equip tools sequentially from the player's Backpack.
